finding: The deployed v4 result is diagnostic only: training rebuilt a bare query prompt, stepped candidates sequentially, and used non-declarative os.urandom seeds.

A sliced baseline worker retained the full task num_instances and backfilled every unselected instance, creating the denominator artifact. Backfill is now disabled only for baseline workers launched with an explicit initial query; whole-rollout fault backfill remains enabled.

For cohort reports, deterministic pre-reward logit-space jitter produced eight unique valid candidates and nonzero counterfactual reward variance on all five gate instances without any model candidate generation; LR0 optimizer execution preserved every trainable parameter bit-for-bit.

PEFT LoRA A initialization is random even though LoRA B starts at zero; separate active/LR0 processes therefore need an explicit shared adapter seed or later update directions are not paired. The fixed-seed implementation restored caller RNG state and produced one bit-identical initial trainable hash in two independent A100 processes.

The group-PG candidate-diversity failure and candidate-distillation efficacy failure cannot support a causal TTT-RL claim. The confirmatory parameter family is now a frozen-tape active-versus-LR0 replay that isolates nonzero prefix updates while preserving exact update inputs and call order.

Rendering frozen optimizer tapes into an ICL prompt is not information-matched and may expose content the optimizer never consumed as text. A canonical reward-aware online ICL trajectory is the defensible strong competitor, with explicit total-algorithm rather than compute-equality interpretation.

A trustworthy online-ICL result needs more than manifest hashes: the validator reconstructs adaptation and held-out outcomes from bound traces, independently re-scores every terminal Cohort action, audits per-condition snapshot restoration, and binds exact generation calls and token accounting.

The online-ICL isolation surface can differ from the base causal branch, but the Cohort corpora, schedules, task, scorer, schemas, templates, and structured-output parser must stay byte-identical. A no-overwrite protocol seal now binds that parity inventory together with source, environment, model, tokenizer, preregistration, and both grid digests before any GPU outcome.

A pre-outcome independent audit found that reward timing needed semantic proof beyond consistent artifact hashes and that a two-row smoke over the internal-screen DGP would create an avoidable efficacy preview. The validator now requires terminal-only, identity-bound, independently rescored reward injection; smoke uses fresh DGP seeds 2026071496/2026071497 and emits only integrity hashes.

Canonical trace publication sorts JSON keys, while QwenLocalSystem stores parsed_action.model_dump_json in live context using Pydantic declaration order. Byte-exact reconstruction therefore must select the trace-bound registered response schema, reject any semantic normalization or coercion, and replay model_dump_json; generic JSON dumping is not an inverse of trace storage.

A successful hardlink-plus-unlink publication and process exit do not prove immediate cross-client SenseiFS visibility: a consumer can transiently observe nlink two, empty metadata, ENOENT, or ESTALE after the producer has completed. Every immediate consumer must bind the original inode and require two identical safe snapshots at least one second apart; visibility timeout is infrastructure-invalid and must never be converted into a scientific decision.
